name: odoo-connector
description: Query and edit your Odoo database through Claude via Odoo's built-in JSON-RPC API. No server-side module required.
long_description: Connects Claude to any Odoo 14–18 instance using Odoo's built-in external API (JSON-RPC over HTTPS). Nothing is installed on the Odoo server — the connector runs locally and authenticates as your user with an API key, so it can do exactly what your Odoo permissions allow. Save several Odoo instances at once in a profiles file; tell Claude which to use or let it pick from the profile descriptions. No profile is a default. Provides tools to introspect models and fields, search and read records, count, call arbitrary model methods, and (optionally) create/update/delete. Write operations are blocked per profile unless that profile sets allow_write.

tools.name: odoo_add_profile
tools.description: Save a new profile (login-checked, always read-only).

tools.name: odoo_update_profile
tools.description: Change a profile's description, username or api_key.

tools.name: odoo_remove_profile
tools.description: Delete a saved profile and its key.

tools.name: odoo_whoami
tools.description: Confirm connection: server version and user id.

tools.name: odoo_find_models
tools.description: Find models by name or label.

tools.name: odoo_fields_get
tools.description: Introspect a model's fields and technical names.

tools.name: odoo_read
tools.description: Read fields for records by id.

tools.name: odoo_create
tools.description: Create a record (needs allow_write on the profile).

tools.name: odoo_write
tools.description: Update records (needs allow_write on the profile).

tools.name: odoo_unlink
tools.description: Delete records (needs allow_write on the profile).

profiles_file.title: Profiles file
profiles_file.description: JSON file of saved Odoo profiles: { "name": { "description", "url", "db", "username", "api_key", "allow_write" } }. Keys are stored in this file in plain text; keep it outside any repo.
